title: Well-posedness threshold of the 2D Euler equations in Hölder spaces on infinite sectors
summary: We study existence and uniqueness for the 2D incompressible Euler equations on infinite sectors of acute angle $β$, focusing on vorticity in Hölder-type spaces. In the inifinite sectors, for every $β$, H"older regularity cannot be expected without decay at infinity. Moreover, the corner causes Schauder-type estimates to fail at sufficiently high regularity. To address these difficulties, we introduce weighted H"older spaces and establish well-posedness for every acute angle, without any decay assumption at infinity.
